mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO logan_crash (app_id,platform,kind,fingerprint,device_id,union_id,user_id,app_version,build_version, brand,model,manufacturer,sdk_int,release_ver,abi,signal_info,top_frames,deferred, crash_time,add_time,content,content_hash) VALUES (#{dto.appId},#{dto.platform},#{dto.kind},#{dto.fingerprint},#{dto.deviceId},#{dto.unionId}, #{dto.userId},#{dto.appVersion},#{dto.buildVersion},#{dto.brand},#{dto.model},#{dto.manufacturer}, #{dto.sdkInt},#{dto.releaseVer},#{dto.abi},#{dto.signalInfo},#{dto.topFrames},#{dto.deferred}, #{dto.crashTime},#{dto.addTime},#{dto.content},#{dto.contentHash})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM logan_crash WHERE app_id=#{appId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint} ORDER BY crash_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM logan_crash WHERE device_id=#{deviceId} ORDER BY crash_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_crash WHERE app_id=#{appId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint}
SELECT * FROM logan_crash_issue WHERE app_id=#{appId} AND fingerprint=#{fingerprint}
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_crash_issue SET last_fix_note = #{lastFixNote} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE logan_crash_issue SET llm_summary=#{llmSummary}, llm_severity=#{llmSeverity} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE logan_crash_issue SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}

sql.if: AND (c.content LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR c.signal_info LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR c.fingerprint LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%'))
AND (i.llm_summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.issueKeyword},'%') OR i.signal_info LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.issueKeyword},'%') OR i.fingerprint LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.issueKeyword},'%'))

ORDER BY c.crash_time DESC LIMIT #{q.offset}, #{q.limit}
